onboarding.welcomeBody: Track income and expenses, plan budgets and reach your savings goals — without connecting your bank.
onboarding.point1: Your data stays on this phone
onboarding.currencyBody: Used for your dashboard, budgets and reports. Each account can still use its own currency.
onboarding.accountBody: Optional. Add where your money is — cash, a bank account, a card…
onboarding.initialBalanceHint: Optional. Leave empty to start at 0.
onboarding.budgetBody: Optional. How much do you want to spend at most this month?

home.noTransactionsBody: Add your first expense or income to see where your money goes.
home.upcomingHint: Planned items are not counted until they are recorded.
home.addFirstAccountBody: Create an account to start recording transactions.

privacy.modeDesc: Hide every amount on screen. Tap the eye icon on the dashboard to switch.

typeHelp.transfer: Moves money between your accounts. Not counted as income or spending.
typeHelp.refund: Money back for a purchase. Reduces the spending of its category.
typeHelp.adjustment: Corrects an account balance. Not counted as income or spending. Use a minus sign to decrease.

tx.repeatHint: Creates a recurring rule. Future occurrences stay planned until their date.
tx.deleteBody: The account balance will be recalculated.
tx.noOtherAccount: Create a second account to make a transfer.

categories.title: Categories
categories.renameHint: Leave empty to keep the built-in name.
categories.inUse: This category is used. It was archived instead of deleted.

accounts.title: Accounts & wallets
accounts.initialBalanceHint: Balance before the first transaction you record. Can be negative for a credit card.
accounts.hasHistory: This account has history, so it can't be deleted. Archive it to hide it while keeping its transactions.
accounts.archivedNote: Archived accounts are hidden from the dashboard; their history stays in reports.
accounts.currencyLocked: Currency can't change once the account has transactions.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.noBudgetBody: Set a monthly limit and limits per category to keep spending under control.
budgets.deleteBody: Only this month's budget is deleted. Your transactions and other months are kept.
budgets.totalLimitHint: Leave empty to use the sum of category limits.
budgets.historyHint: Each month keeps its own budget. Starting a new month never erases the old one.
budgets.currencyNote: Only spending in {{currency}} counts toward this budget, unless you set an exchange rate.
budgets.freeLimit: Free plan: up to {{count}} category limits per month.

settings.title: Settings
settings.thresholdsDesc: Show an alert when spending reaches these percentages of a budget.
settings.budgetNotificationsDesc: Local notification when a threshold is reached (no amounts shown).
settings.subscriptionRemindersDesc: Local notification before a renewal, for subscriptions with a reminder.
settings.notificationsDenied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in Android settings.
settings.disclaimer: SpendWise is a personal tracking and planning tool. It is not a bank, does not move money and does not provide financial advice.

currency.title: Currencies
currency.mainDesc: Dashboard, budgets and reports use this currency.
currency.ratesDesc: SpendWise never converts automatically. Add a manual rate to include another currency in your totals.
currency.noRates: No exchange rates. Amounts in other currencies are shown separately.

stats.excluded_one: {{count}} transaction in another currency is not included (no exchange rate).
stats.excluded_other: {{count}} transactions in other currencies are not included (no exchange rate).

subs.title: Subscriptions
subs.notPayments: Tracked subscriptions are reminders and estimates, not payments. Record a payment to add it to your transactions.
subs.emptyBody: Track streaming, software, phone plans or gym to see what they cost per month and per year.
subs.reminderHint: Reminders need subscription reminders enabled in Settings.
subs.recordHint: Paid this subscription? Record it as an expense in one of your accounts.
subs.deleteBody: Payments already recorded stay in your transactions.

goals.perMonth_one: Save {{amount}} this month to reach it
goals.perMonth_other: Save {{amount}} / month for {{count}} months to reach it
goals.title: Savings goals
goals.intro: Set a target and track what you put aside.
goals.emptyBody: Create an emergency fund, a vacation or any goal and follow your progress.
goals.recommendedFormula_one: Remaining amount spread over {{count}} month (rounded up).
goals.recommendedFormula_other: Remaining amount divided by {{count}} months left (rounded up).
goals.trackingOnly: Contributions are tracking only: they are not counted as spending and do not change account balances.
goals.deleteBody: The goal and its contribution history will be deleted. Your transactions are not affected.

recurring.title: Recurring transactions
recurring.intro: Salary, rent, bills… Due occurrences are recorded on their date, never in advance.
recurring.emptyBody: Add your salary, rent or bills to stop typing them every month.
recurring.toConfirmHint: These occurrences are due. They are not recorded until you confirm them.
recurring.plannedHint: Future occurrences are projections. They are not counted in balances or reports.
recurring.autoPostOn: Each occurrence is recorded automatically on its date.
recurring.autoPostOff: Each occurrence waits for your confirmation.
recurring.editHint: Changes apply to future occurrences. Transactions already recorded are kept.
recurring.deleteBody: Future occurrences stop. Transactions already recorded are kept in your history.

insights.categoryLess: You spent {{pct}}% less on {{category}} than last period.
insights.categoryMore: You spent {{pct}}% more on {{category}} than last period.

insights.spendingMore: Your total spending is {{pct}}% higher than last period.
insights.savingsRate: You kept {{pct}}% of your income this period.
insights.overspent: You spent {{pct}}% more than you earned this period.

reports.recurringDesc: Spending recorded by your recurring rules in this period.
reports.emptyBody: Reports are built only from the transactions you record.
reports.lockedBody: The year view and period comparisons are part of Premium.
reports.watchAd: Watch an ad to unlock for 24 h
reports.adUnavailable: No ad available right now. Please try later.

calculators.title: Calculators
calculators.subtitle: Quick planning tools. Results are estimates, not financial advice.

budget.title: Monthly Budget
budget.desc: See what's left after planned expenses and savings.

savings.title: Savings Goal
savings.desc: How much to save each month, or how long it takes.

split.title: Expense Split
split.desc: Split a bill fairly, with tip and shares.

salary.title: Salary Breakdown
salary.desc: Convert a salary between year, month, week and hour.

debt.title: Debt Repayment
debt.desc: Payoff time and interest for a fixed payment.

budget.formula: Available = income − planned expenses − (income × savings %). The 50/30/20 split divides income into needs, wants and savings.

savings.formula: Remaining = target − saved. Monthly = remaining ÷ months (rounded up). Months = remaining ÷ monthly (rounded up). No interest is assumed.

split.weightsHint: One whole number per person. Leave empty for equal parts.
split.formula: Tip = total × tip %. The total with tip is split by shares; remaining cents go to the first people so parts always add up exactly.

salary.deductionHint: Your own estimate of taxes and contributions. SpendWise doesn't use tax tables.
salary.formula: Based on 12 months, 26 two-week periods, 52 weeks, 260 working days and your hours per week. Net = gross × (1 − deductions %).

debt.tooLow: This payment doesn't cover the monthly interest ({{amount}}).
debt.tooLong: Payoff would take more than 50 years.
debt.targetTitle: Payment needed for a target duration
debt.formula: Each month: interest = balance × annual rate ÷ 12 (rounded to the cent); the payment covers interest first, the rest reduces the balance. The last payment is reduced to what's left.

data.title: Data & backup
data.localOnly: Your financial data never leaves this phone unless you export it. Exports open the Android share menu: you choose where the file goes.
data.exportCsvDesc: A spreadsheet-friendly file of your transactions.
data.importCsvDesc: Use the SpendWise CSV format (comma or semicolon separated, dates as YYYY-MM-DD, amounts with a dot). You'll see a preview before anything is saved.
data.previewFallback_one: {{count}} row has an unknown category and will use "Other".
data.previewFallback_other: {{count}} rows have an unknown category and will use "Other".

csvErrors.missing_columns: Required columns are missing. Check the header line.
csvErrors.too_many_rows: This file has too many rows (max 20,000).

data.backupDesc: A JSON file with all your accounts, transactions, budgets, goals and settings. Keep it somewhere safe: it is not encrypted.
data.restoreConfirmBody: Backup from {{date}} with {{transactions}} transactions and {{accounts}} accounts. ALL data currently in SpendWise will be replaced. Create a backup first if you're unsure.
data.restoreFailed: Restore failed. Your current data was kept.

backupErrors.invalid_json: This file is not a valid backup.
backupErrors.invalid_format: This backup is damaged or incomplete.
backupErrors.wrong_app: This backup was made by another app.
backupErrors.newer_schema: This backup comes from a newer SpendWise version. Update the app first.

data.deleteDesc: Erases every account, transaction, budget, goal and setting from this phone. This can't be undone.
data.deleteBody: Everything will be permanently erased from this phone. Your Google Play subscription is not cancelled by this.

paywall.title: SpendWise Premium
paywall.subtitle: Plan further, see more, without ads.
paywall.legal: Billed by Google Play. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Google Play.
paywall.nothingToRestore: No purchase found for this Google account.

paywall.error: The purchase couldn't be completed. You were not charged.
paywall.unavailable: Purchases aren't available in this build.
paywall.freeStays: Everything you need to track your money stays free.

privacyScreen.title: Privacy
privacyScreen.localTitle: Your data stays on your phone
privacyScreen.localBody: Accounts, transactions, budgets and goals are stored only in this app's local database. There is no SpendWise server and no cloud sync.
privacyScreen.noBankBody: SpendWise never asks for bank logins and can't access your bank. You enter your own figures.
privacyScreen.noUploadBody: Exports and backups are files you share yourself through Android. Android auto-backup is turned off for this app.
privacyScreen.encryptionBody: Data is protected by Android's app sandbox. SpendWise does not add its own database encryption or PIN lock yet, and backup files are not encrypted.
privacyScreen.adsBody: The free version shows Google AdMob ads on a few screens without amounts. AdMob may use device identifiers according to your consent choices. No amount, description, account name or other financial information is ever sent to ads.
privacyScreen.analyticsBody: Off by default. If you allow it, only anonymous usage events are counted (e.g. "a budget was created") — never amounts, currencies, names, descriptions or balances.
privacyScreen.deleteBody: You can export everything or delete all your data at any time from Data & backup.
privacyScreen.analyticsToggleDesc: Helps improve SpendWise. No financial data.
